QUOTE: Built-in allocator. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-576`) hands the library a caller-supplied buffer as its heap. It installs its own calloc and free through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function installs its own calloc/free via the runtime setter. It never says "only in-tree user", but it does name the allocator, the init function and the installation mechanism.
